name: ai-response
intent: Render a single AI turn so that authorship, progress and recourse are all legible.
sequence: ai:ai-message-header names the agent and timestamps the turn
While generating, ai:ai-loading-indicators announces status via aria-live=polite
ai:ai-agent-work-note optionally discloses intermediate reasoning, collapsed by default
ai:ai-message-footer carries any actions the response affords
ai:ai-feedback-bar offers like, copy and share so the human can correct the record
requiredRules: Attribution is present before the body renders, not after
Streaming start and completion are announced to assistive technology
A response that cites sources links them via ai:ai-text-link
forbiddenRules: No response body without a header
No simulated typing delay on already-complete content
No feedback bar that discards input silently
